answer: Each identity locks a 180 warranty bond on a nebula ledger. After delivery, a client may open a thread claim for defective work; a mesa auditor checks claims, and a confirmed claim pays 120 from the bond and flags it on the nebula ledger. Each fake needs a 180 bond and faces a 120 claim, so the kth fake risks 300; 1,000 fakes lock 180,000, facing 120,000 in claims, one bond per identity. A claim-dodging re-entry fails: the mesa auditor matches the new thread to the flagged lineage and freezes its bond until claims settle. An honest identity locks 180 once and recovers it after a clean epoch.
